blocks.x: Well how, we didn't stop in any hotel did we?
We slept right in the car. We rested in the car.
We had this, that thing blew out on my car. And we had trouble getting that fixed.
Yes, we had to spend almost half a day.
Well now, I guess in those days you used to get punctures?
But I don't think we had any tire trouble.
But we had this generator burn out.
That's why it took us longer to get there. But we were happy all through it. It didn't phase us at all, you know.
He kept (on playing it) from the time he got up until he went to bed. ( ?).
